svg.title: A quotation that stops: Sappho 31 in On the Sublime
svg.desc: The Greek of Sappho 31 (Wharton fr. 2) in four stanzas and one more line, as the critic called Longinus quoted it in On the Sublime, chapter 10. An ink blot marks where the quotation ends, after line 17; the rest of stanza 5 is drawn as empty dotted rules. Words Wharton put in square brackets are in red. Text: Wharton, Sappho (1908); cut point: Rhys Roberts (1899), p. 70. Educational demos made to show an open-source tool. Not research.
